content: The execution was successful (Reward 1.0). The provided instructions correctly identified the critical technical challenges of HWPX manipulation: 1) handling placeholders split across multiple XML text runs (`<hp:t>`), 2) the necessity of removing layout-cache elements (`<hp:lineSegArray>`) to force layout recalculation, and 3) the specific ZIP packaging requirements (preserving structure and mimetype storage). This approach effectively bypasses the need for complex HWP-specific libraries by treating the format as a standard Open Packaging Convention (OPC) ZIP of XMLs.
